translation.english_text: (In the hotel room, a hotel boy brings Paranthaman a telegram and leaves. Paranthaman opens and reads it with joy. The office boy enters.)
We've got our Kumudha's address. She's sent a telegram. Hmm...... hmm...... Put together the doll, rattle and everything we bought for the child.
I will bring renewal to the ruined family.
notes: This is source-visible direct speech after the boy leaves, but the booklet does not repeat a speaker label; no dialogue-record ID or speaker is invented.
